extension.description: Visual Studio Code plugin that autocompletes filenames
configuration.title: path-intellisense
configuration.path-intellisense.extensio: Adds the file extension to a import statements
configuration.path-intellisense.mappings: Mappings for paths.  The values should be interpreted as absolute paths (and can use '${workspaceFolder}')
configuration.path-intellisense.absolute: Sets an absolute path to the current workspace
If defined, unmapped absolute path imports are based on this location.  Takes priority over 'absolutePathToWorkspace' if both are defined
configuration.path-intellisense.showOnAb: Shows suggestions when the import starts with a forward slash ('/')
configuration.path-intellisense.autoTrig: Automatically triggers next suggestion after previous suggestion
